production.format_and_medium.authority: Lake v. City of Phoenix, 222 Ariz. 547, 218 P.3d 1004 (2009)
production.format_and_medium.summary: When a public record is maintained in an electronic medium, it must be produced in that electronic medium including embedded metadata, on request.

production.delivery_and_completion.summary: The custodian shall promptly furnish the requested copies, printouts or photographs (a soft-standard timing duty, not a numeric deadline).

production.inspection_access.summary: If the custodian lacks facilities to make copies of a record the person has a right to inspect, the person shall be granted access to make copies, while the record stays in the custodian's possession and under the custodian's supervision.

intake.purpose_and_certification.summary: At the time of the request the requester shall affirm the record is not for a commercial purpose, or, if it is, agree to provide a commercial-purpose statement under § 39-121.03(A).
A requester seeking copies for a commercial purpose shall provide a statement setting forth the commercial purpose for which the copies will be used.

eligibility.any_person.summary: Any person may inspect public records in the custody of any officer; the statute grants the right to 'any person' without qualification as to who the requester is.

eligibility.no_purpose_requirement.summary: A requester need not state a reason or purpose to obtain public records, except that a requester must affirm the record is not for a commercial purpose and, if it is, must supply a commercial-purpose statement.

eligibility.no_residency_requirement.summary: There is no residency requirement to request public records; the right runs to 'any person,' not to residents or citizens of Arizona.

Master.s1.label: Fee-waiver requested

fee.waiver.summary: State, county, and municipal officers shall furnish, without charge, searches for and certified copies of public records needed in support of a claim or benefit application against the United States.

A victim of a listed offense (or the victim's attorney, or immediate family of a deceased/incapacitated victim) has the right to receive one copy of the police report, and audio/video recordings, at no charge.

Master.s1.city_config: fee_waiver approval module (v1, DESIGN_fee_waiver_commercial.md): enabled on/off governs the DISCRETIONARY program only — statutory-mandatory waiver categories fire regardless, on verified evidence. mode = intake_review (inline approve/deny) | routed_task {assignee_role, task_name}.
